basis.governing_question: Which new point-of-sale system should Farmácias Lusas choose, and how can it be rolled out to its 40 pharmacies?

sub_questions.question: What must the new point-of-sale system do in each pharmacy process area?
Where does the current system fall short of those requirements?
Which point-of-sale vendor best meets the requirements, and what business case supports choosing it?
How is the chosen system configured, tested and loaded with data from the current system?
How does the new system get running in all 40 pharmacies, pilot site first, then in waves?

work.unit: Process area mapped with its requirements

phase_work.why: Four process areas mapped two at a time, with stakeholder interviews running alongside; within the archetype's typical 3 to 6 weeks.
One shortlist, demonstration and scoring round, no formal tender; within the archetype's typical 4 to 8 weeks.

work.unit: System configured and tested for one process area
Rollout wave of up to 10 sites

phase_work.why: Four process areas configured two at a time; pilot site first, then the other 39 pharmacies in four waves of up to 10.

sizing.levers: Configuring fewer process areas in a first release, or running rollout waves two at a time, would shorten Implementation most.

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Document what each pharmacy process area needs from a point-of-sale system and where the current system falls short.

gate.label: Requirements sign-off
gate.decision: Go or no-go on vendor selection against the signed-off requirements?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Score vendors against the requirements and set out the business case for the preferred system.

gate.label: Vendor selection
gate.decision: Which vendor goes forward to implementation, and is the business case approved?

phases.name: Implementation
phases.objective_one_line: Configure and test the chosen system, prove it at a pilot pharmacy and roll it out to all 40.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Approve the new point-of-sale system as running in all 40 pharmacies?

architect_notes: Engagement length is an estimate (33 to 39 weeks in total) because none was given; confirm it before quoting.
Implementation takes the middle of a 21 to 31 week estimate; more process areas or slower rollout waves would push it to the top.
The count of four process areas is assumed; five would add 5 to 8 weeks across Diagnostic and Implementation, so confirm it.
Implementation is added after the archetype's Diagnostic and Design, with the pilot site and rollout waves inside it, not in a separate Pilot phase.
No formal tender is planned; if Farmácias Lusas must run one, Design grows by 4 to 6 weeks.
